question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ransack
solution:
The correct answer is '**Protect**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Ransack**' is '**Protect**'.
 
• **Ransack**: to search a place, making it untidy and causing damage, usually because you are looking for something. (सामान को उलट-पुलट करते हुए और हानि पहुँचाते हुए किसी स्‍थान पर वस्‍तु विशेष की खोजबीन करना)
 
 
• *Example: The house had been **ransacked** by burglars.*
 
 
 
• **Protect**: to keep somebody/something safe; to defend somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को सुरक्षित रखना; व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की रक्षा करना)
 
 
• *Example: Parents try to **protect** their children from danger as far as possible.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Protect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Pilfer**: to steal something in small quantity or of little value, especially from the place where you work. (छिटपुट चोरी, विशेषतः कार्यस्‍थल से)
 
• **Raid**: a short surprise attack on an enemy by soldiers, ships, or aircraft. (थल-सैनिकों, पानी के जहाज़ों या विमानों से शत्रु पर अचानक आक्रमण)
 
• **Seize**: to take hold of something suddenly and firmly; to grab something. (किसी वस्‍तु को एकाएक और कसकर पकड़ लेना; छीन लेना, झपट लेना)
